description: Import-performance envelope for `import penampakan` (specification 05 D4). The recorded medians are machine-relative documentation only; the enforced contract is the penampakan/control ratio plus an absolute emergency ceiling, so the test does not become a fixed wall-clock assertion across arbitrary hardware.
measurement: median of `samples` fresh-subprocess `import penampakan` timings (time.perf_counter inside the child), after discarding `warmup_samples` runs
control_rationale: A stdlib-only import of comparable weight, measured in the same job with the same harness. It absorbs interpreter, filesystem, and CPU speed differences between machines, so the ratio stays stable while a real regression (a provider SDK, Torch, eager weight loading) moves it by an order of magnitude.
tolerance_rationale: Allows the observed ratio to grow to 15.75x before failing. Five consecutive calibration runs on the recording machine spanned 6.19x-6.39x, so the headroom is roughly 2.5x the healthy value; importing Torch or a provider SDK costs hundreds of milliseconds to seconds and pushes the ratio far beyond it.
emergency_ceiling_rationale: Absolute backstop for a catastrophic regression, about 22x the recorded median. Generous enough that a slow, heavily loaded CI runner never trips it on healthy code.

recorded_on.note: Editable install of penampakan 0.2.1 with Pillow and pydantic present. Re-record these numbers only together with an ADR explaining why the ratio changed.
